items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: He came here with Leroy Smith, at the Apollo Theater.

ctx.x: Leroy Smith. He came here with Leroy Smith, at the Apollo Theater. And he would drink a whole glass of whiskey before he went on stage. Clear his voice, he said. And, oh, he could sing, George Dewey Washington, yeah. Great entertainer.
